newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bongaigaon 96/97 net dips sharply.
newsitem.headline: India Bongaigaon 96/97 net dips sharply.

text.p: India's state-run crude oil refiner Bongaigaon Refinery and Petrochemicals Ltd said on Thursday that its net profit in 1996/97 (April-March) fell sharply to 290 million rupees from 901 million in 1995/96.

The company said in a statement that the board of directors had recommended a dividend of 30 percent of the net profit in 1996/97. "It may be noted that the company had paid dividend to the shareholders equal to 30 percent of the net profit in the previous year 1995/96 too," the statement said.

A company official told Reuters that the actual dividend payout in 1996/97 would be lower with the sharp fall in the net profit. The total dividend payout would likely dip to 87 million rupees, from 270.5 million in 1995/96.
The company posted a profit before tax of 303.4 million rupees in 1996/97 compared with 1.2 billion rupees in 1995/96, the statement said.
It said the company processed 1.54 million tonnes of crude in 1996/97, 27 percent higher than the previous year.
Sales in 1996/97 totalled 8.4 billion rupees compared with 8.12 billion in 1995/96.
Bongaigaon Refinery attributed the fall in profits to a dip in prices of the company's major products in the global market.
